currentUserGoal: Make the live game UI closer to the polished mockup: readable top stat chips, a visible trigger feed, and a phone-friendly command dock.
changesMade: Replaced the old single-line resource HUD display with compact stat chips for touches, seeds, gold, auto income, and ready quests.
Added a Trigger Feed panel that logs automation, hazards, weather, quest, shop, mutation, mower, and spread events.
Added a compact mobile Trigger Feed layout with fewer rows so the feed appears on phone screens without taking over the field.
Moved the mobile command menu into a bottom dock and made the world-object placement dock sit above it.
Kept old resourceText hidden as a fallback object while the new chip HUD owns the visible display.
Added compact number formatting for very large HUD values so stress-mode values do not overflow the chips.

verificationRun.check: Playwright screenshot pass via local Chrome
verificationRun.details: Captured desktop 918x854 and mobile 390x844 stress views. Confirmed stat chips, trigger feed, and mobile dock render. Confirmed world-object dock no longer overlaps the bottom command dock.
